rv.q: It is the same when Sheehan enters wearing that voluminous great coat and when he and Adonis Siddique as Marwood – the “I” of the title – take to the road in a real-life Jaguar Mk2. No fault of the show, but it is as if it exists to enable fans of the film to relive a shared moment.
Released in 1987, the original movie of Withnail and I is regularly seen among lists of the greatest films, often regarded as one of the all time great British films.
